title: High-gamma dataset described in Schirrmeister et al. 2017
description: The High-gamma dataset contains 128-channel EEG recordings from 14 healthy participants performing cue-based executed movements of the left hand, right hand and feet, plus rest. It was introduced to evaluate end-to-end decoding with deep convolutional neural networks against filter bank common spatial patterns (FBCSP), and to visualize the spectral power modulations these networks learn. This version is a BIDS-formatted derivative generated with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz from 128 channels using BCI2000. Participants performed repetitive movements (sequential finger-tapping for each hand, toe clenching for the feet) or rested, as cued by gray arrows on a black background. Each subject completed about 13 runs of 80 four-second trials, with 3-4 s inter-trial intervals and pseudo-randomized class order.
